description: By-value Lens panel (type lens, ES|QL textBased datasource, lnsXY line chart with a split column) taken read-only from an existing dashboard; ids, panelIndex and appliedTimeRange removed. Pointers are RFC 6901 into template.lens-esql.json. The ES|QL string appears at both esql_string and esql_string_state_query and both must be set; the column identifiers must also be changed consistently in the datasource columns (columnId, fieldName, label) and the visualization layer accessors.
